title: Phoenix Protocol: Verify CloudWatch visibility using describe-alarms (read-only, deterministic).
objectives: Describe the purpose of CloudWatch in AWS
Identify the command to list all alarms in a given region
Understand the importance of alarm visibility

mission_brief.situation: You are operating as a secure cloud operator in an authorized sandbox where resources may or may not exist.
mission_brief.mission: Verify access safely using read-only AWS CLI commands without assuming any pre-existing resources.
mission_brief.execution: Run discovery-only commands and validate success by deterministic behavior (successful execution), not resource presence.

content.concept: CloudWatch provides monitoring and logging capabilities for AWS resources. Describing alarms lists all configured alarms, including their status and configuration. Deterministic validation means you confirm the command executed successfully without relying on resource names, counts, o
content.walkthrough: To verify CloudWatch visibility using describe-alarms, navigate to the AWS Management Console and select the region where your alarms are located. Then, click on the 'Alarms' tab in the left-hand menu. Finally, click on the 'Describe Alarms' button to list all configured alarms.
checkpoints: Verify that you have access to the CloudWatch console
Identify the correct region where your alarms are located
List all configured alarms using describe-alarms
common_mistakes: Using describe-alarms on an incorrect region
Not understanding alarm status and configuration

lab.setup: Ensure AWS CLI is configured with sandbox credentials. Do not create, modify, or delete any resources.
safety: Use read-only AWS CLI commands only (list/describe/get).
Do not reference named resources unless the lesson explicitly created them (this v2 track does not).
If you see AccessDenied, stop and verify permissions rather than trying write actions.

elite_competence.role_simulation: A CloudWatch administrator is responsible for monitoring and logging AWS resources. They must be able to describe alarms, understand alarm status, and configure alerts.

bug_injection.bug: Operator assumes resources must exist and mislabels empty output as failure.
bug_injection.symptom: Student reports 'nothing returned' and believes permissions are broken.
bug_injection.fix: Explain empty-sandbox behavior and validate by successful execution + no errors, not by finding assets.

pass_conditions: Describing alarms lists all configured alarms
Alarm visibility is crucial for monitoring and logging
The correct region was used when describing alarms
fail_conditions: Access to the CloudWatch console was denied
Alarms were not listed in the expected format
The incorrect region was used when describing alarms

interrogation_questions: What is the purpose of CloudWatch in AWS?
How do you list all configured alarms using describe-alarms?
Why is alarm visibility important for monitoring and logging?

legal_context.allowed: Executing read-only AWS CLI commands in an authorized sandbox or training account.
legal_context.prohibited: Creating, deleting, or modifying AWS resources without explicit authorization.

resume_bullets: Ability to describe alarms using command-line interface
Knowledge of alarm status and configuration
